name: B10-0133/2026 (ECR) – Systemic oppression, inhumane conditions and arbitrary detentions by the regime in Iran
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the systemic oppression, inhumane conditions and arbitrary detentions by the regime in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns Iran's regime for killing protesters, holding political prisoners in harsh conditions, and arresting European and dual nationals on false charges. It calls for the release of all imprisoned demonstrators and political prisoners, and for prisoners' rights to medical care, family visits and lawyers. It also asks the European Union to build a strategy against Iran's practice of detaining foreigners as bargaining chips, and welcomes new sanctions and the listing of Iran's Revolutionary Guard as a terrorist organisation.

- The text is an opinion and a set of demands; it changes no law itself.
- It targets Iran's government, prisoners, detainees' families and EU governments.
- Next: EU countries and the Council are urged to act on sanctions and a detainee task force.
